title: Microwave Cinnamon Apple
description: A warm cinnamon apple dessert for one in minutes.
substitutions: Skip oats or add a spoonful of granola after cooking.

steps.text: Put diced apple in a microwave-safe bowl with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, and optional oats.
Cover loosely and microwave 2 minutes. Stir.
Microwave 30–60 seconds more until the apple is tender. Let stand 1 minute before eating.

title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
description: Warm toast with peanut butter, banana, and cinnamon.
substitutions: Use almond or sunflower butter if preferred.

steps.text: Spread each with 1 tablespoon peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana and a pinch of cinnamon.

title: Leftover Mashed Potato Cakes
description: Crisp little skillet cakes that turn leftover mashed potatoes into lunch or a side.
substitutions: Use breadcrumbs instead of some of the flour if the potatoes are very soft.

steps.text: Mix 2 cups cold mashed potatoes with egg, flour, and optional cheese.
Shape into 8 small patties. If sticky, dust your hands with flour.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium. Cook patties 3–4 minutes per side until deeply golden and hot through.
